name: 글라이거
scene: Open cliffside aerial maintenance bay at violet dusk, magenta rim lights and cool blue reflections.
motifs: Long triangular ears become sleek purple angular hair ornaments; gliding membranes become a split blue-and-purple cape from the shoulders; curved stinger becomes a tapering belt sash with a rounded tip; claw shapes become forearm plate edges, with ordinary separate five-finger human gloves.

casual.scene: Empty rooftop exercise terrace at bright morning, warming up with one heel lifted and both arms relaxed outward below shoulder height. Full body and shoes visible, blue skyline and crisp sunlight.
casual.outfit: Opaque violet racerback athletic crop top, high-waisted navy running shorts, purple trainers and tiny triangular silver ear studs. Bare midriff, shoulders and legs; secure sports clothing.

casual.scene: Empty airshow styling booth at blue twilight, torso side-on and face toward camera. One hand adjusts an unlettered ticket pouch resting on counter; other open hand lies separately on counter. Both hands visible.
casual.outfit: Original airshow hostess event fashion: opaque purple halter-neck fitted cropped waistcoat with silver piping, high-waisted blue pleated miniskirt, no institutional insignia, small bat-wing earrings. Bare arms and midriff, chest and pelvis covered.

casual.scene: Empty riverside tram shelter on a rainy evening, perched on a low bench watching rain, one open hand on each side of bench, both hands fully inside knee-up crop. Soft orange city bokeh and blue puddle light.
casual.outfit: Opaque blue one-shoulder knit top, violet high-waisted tailored wide-leg shorts, ankle boots and one tiny curved silver bracelet. Bare shoulder, arms and legs, ordinary evening fashion.
